import sys

def main():
    data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()))
    n, m = data[0], data[1]
    slope_tree = [0] * (n + 1)
    intercept_tree = [0] * (n + 1)

    def update(pos, ds, db):
        while pos <= n:
            slope_tree[pos] += ds
            intercept_tree[pos] += db
            pos += pos & -pos

    out = []
    p = 2

    for _ in range(m):
        typ = data[p]
        i = data[p + 1]

        if typ == 3:
            s = b = 0
            pos = i
            while pos:
                s += slope_tree[pos]
                b += intercept_tree[pos]
                pos -= pos & -pos
            out.append(str(s * i + b))
            p += 2
        else:
            v = data[p + 2]
            if typ == 1:
                left, right = i, min(n, i + v - 1)
                ds, db = -1, v + i
            else:
                left, right = max(1, i - v + 1), i
                ds, db = 1, v - i

            update(left, ds, db)
            if right < n:
                update(right + 1, -ds, -db)
            p += 3

    sys.stdout.write("\n".join(out))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
